author: reactive-end
summary: `anvil orchestrator tools`: lists the MCP servers in Claude Code's config (project .mcp.json, local and user ~/.claude.json, enabled plugins named plugin_<plugin>_<server>) and lets the user check which ones executors load, or use --add/--remove/--list. It writes orchestrator.executor_tools and re-syncs anvil-executor.md. Unit and e2e tests, clippy, and anvil check pass. Commit 9bfb652.
